description_short: The City of West Haven's Parks and Recreation Department runs a summer day camp. This page lists only a phone number for the camp. Program details are posted on the department's RecUS registration site.
special_needs_notes: The department says anyone with a disability who may need a reasonable modification or help to take part in its programs should call the office (203-937-3651).
